brief.ask: Art-direct "Celestial Silk Veil" — #7 of the 72 Ambo church visualizers (Calm Contemporary Worship lyric visualizer, Collection I of 72; subgenre Contemporary Abstract). Premise: Flowing gossamer ribbons of champagne gold and amethyst silk with golden threads. Translucent fabric veils of warm champagne and deep sanctuary violet billow in slow zero-gravity currents with spun-gold selvedge threads. Lighting today: Key: Rim-lit gossamer silk at 4000K over deep aubergine void. Service use: Contemporary worship ballads, Holy Spirit invocation, altar ministry. Audio mapping today: Vocal → Lifts silk ribbon crests with breath-like undulation; Swell → Increases champagne-gold rim translucency; Bass → Slows and deepens the lower fold wave wavelength. Palette: #0B0814 #2A1B3D #C9965B #FAF0E4. Keep the id, name, premise and palette; rebuild the direction: the geometry and depth planes, typography for the worship lyric band (one line at a time, four to five seconds a line, word-by-word progression), image logic (how the procedural scene (no concept plate: the plate is generative, in code) and the procedural scene meet), texture, motion, and which audio channel drives what. Decide it — the lead's lens will drive the kit's material weave and optical pass for this one.
brief.audience: Congregations watching a projector or LED wall from the pews, five to forty metres away, eyes on the words; and the worship leader or volunteer running Ambo live from a laptop.
brief.feeling: Stillness and reverence — a sanctuary that breathes with the singer's voice; gorgeous, slow, never a screensaver.
constraints: Build method (fixed): a real-time Canvas 2D audio-reactive renderer in Plajah's worship visualizer kit — sanctuary background, multi-plane depth (god rays, motes, bokeh), the kit's Council optical pass (35mm light leaks, anamorphic flare, film grain, colour punch, and a tactile material weave keyed to the LEAD director's lens) and the kit's lyric / scripture typography engine. No video playback, no WebGL, no assets beyond the one concept plate.

Audio drives amplitude, colour, light, growth and glow only — never the position of the words. Envelopes are smoothed; nothing strobes or flashes (photosensitive-safe); uptempo pulses are spring-damped.

The reading band is sacred: lyrics or scripture must stay legible at 1920×1080 and 4K from the back pew, over the busiest moment of the scene. A text-safe dimming band is part of the kit; direct how the scene yields to it.

Typefaces are fixed to the kit's open-licensed set: Noto Serif (text serif), Outfit / Inter (sans), Cinzel (display), JetBrains Mono. Direct scale, case, tracking, measure and hierarchy, not new families.

Sacred imagery is used correctly and respectfully: biblical places and objects are specific and attributable, never costume; nothing denominational or branded; nothing that reads as a music video or a screensaver.
Runs at 60 fps on an integrated-GPU laptop driving a projector: favour layered gradients, cached textures and a few large shapes over particle storms.
Keep this visualizer's id, name, premise and four-colour palette. The council owns the direction, not the catalogue entry.
references: No concept plate: the scene is built entirely in code from the premise.
Sample lyric lines on the band: "Be still my soul the Lord is on thy side" / "Bear patiently the cross of grief or pain".

proposals.title: Cantus Firmus in Silk
proposals.idea: Five governing axes — declared as code constants before any draw call — divide the void into a proportional nave, from which every ribbon plane, rim-light arc, mote position, and lyric interval derives its measure, so the scene reads as a single resolved composition rather than accumulated atmosphere.
proposals.geometry: Five vertical bay axes spaced by the golden section (1 : 1.618) across the 16:9 field, calculated from canvas centre outward: axes at approximately x = 0.191W, 0.309W, 0.500W, 0.691W, 0.809W. These constants govern everything simultaneously — ribbon spline anchor columns, rim-light arc origins, mote seed columns, bokeh halo x-positions, and the lyric band centre-line. Depth is three planes: (1) aubergine void ground (#0B0814 → #2A1B3D radial, full bleed); (2) mid-plane ribbon field, three to four large gossamer veil shapes per frame, billowing between adjacent axes; (3) foreground selvedge threads — four to six near-vertical spline strands, thicker, catching rim light, crossing the lyric safe zone only above and below the text band. The lyric band occupies the harmonic centre: a horizontal field from y = 0.55H to y = 0.80H, width bounded by axes 2–4, so the text never touches the outer b
proposals.typography: Cinzel Regular for the primary lyric line — display weight, all-caps, tracked at +0.12em, set at 6.8vw on 1080p (scales to 4K by viewport unit). One line at a time. Word-by-word reveal: each word fades in over 180 ms at full opacity; preceding words hold at 88% opacity and reduce tracking by 0.01em per word added, so the line breathes inward as it fills — a typographic inhalation. At line completion the full line rests for the remaining duration (four to five seconds total per line); on exit, the line dissolves upward 8px over 320 ms, not a cut. Scripture reference or song title below in Noto Serif Italic, 2.1vw, tracking +0.06em, #FAF0E4 at 55% opacity — never competes. No Inter or Mono on this kit: the nave is classical, the face must carry it. Cinzel is the cantus firmus of the type column.
proposals.imageLogic: No concept plate. The scene is entirely procedural. Ribbon veils are cubic Bézier splines with six to eight control points per ribbon, anchored to the five bay axes; control points are offset by low-frequency Perlin noise (octave 1, frequency 0.004, amplitude 0.12H) so the fabric moves without mechanical repetition. Each ribbon carries two rendering passes: (1) a filled translucent shape in #2A1B3D at 18–28% alpha — the silk body; (2) a stroked highlight path 1.5px wide in #C9965B at 35–55% alpha — the spun-gold selvedge, drawn along the upper edge of each ribbon. Rim-light arcs are wide elliptical gradient strokes (radialGradient from arc origin to ribbon edge) in #FAF0E4 → transparent, blending mode 'screen', keyed to amplitude. Motes are 80–120 small circles (r = 1.2–2.8px) seeded deterministically by hashing their index against the five axis x-values — they do not drift randomly; the
proposals.texture: The material weave for this kit's Council optical pass is simulated fine-weave silk: a tiled 128×128 canvas texture (generated once at init, cached) of diagonal micro-lines at 45°, 0.3px stroke, #FAF0E4 at 4% opacity, composited over the ribbon fill shapes with blending mode 'overlay'. This gives the gossamer its tooth without cost. Film grain layer: a 512×512 noise canvas re-seeded every 3 frames (not every frame — 20 fps grain update is invisible and saves GPU), composited at 2.5% opacity, mode 'soft-light'. Anamorphic flare: two horizontal linear gradients 1px tall, extending full canvas width from each rim-light arc origin, in #C9965B at 6% alpha — drawn last, above everything, mode 'screen'. Colour punch: a vignette radialGradient #0B0814 at 55% alpha from corners, applied as the final compositing step. No light leak assets; the leak is a horizontal gradient rect drawn at a governed
proposals.motion: Temporal hierarchy is declared before any draw call — three envelope constants: RIBBON_PERIOD = 11.0 s (full slow undulation cycle, one ribbon crest to next); MOTE_PERIOD = 9.5 s (vertical orbit); LYRIC_WORD_FADE = 180 ms. Nothing moves faster than LYRIC_WORD_FADE except the smoothed audio envelope itself. Audio mapping: Vocal amplitude (smoothed, 80 ms attack, 400 ms release) lifts ribbon control-point y-offsets by up to 0.06H — the crests rise like an inhalation, fall on silence. Swell (low-pass RMS, 200 ms window) increases the rim-light arc gradient stop opacity from 35% toward 72% — champagne gold brightens as the arrangement swells, dims as it recedes. Bass (sub-band RMS, 300 ms window) modulates RIBBON_PERIOD: at full bass energy the period lengthens to 16 s; at silence it returns to 11 s — the lower folds slow and deepen, they do not throb. Spring-damping on all envelopes: k = 0.
proposals.productionMethod: Canvas 2D renderer, 60 fps, integrated-GPU safe. Init phase (runs once): compute five axis constants; generate and cache the 128×128 silk weave texture and the 512×512 grain canvas; pre-calculate ribbon spline anchor arrays for three ribbon instances per plane. Draw loop order: (1) void ground gradient; (2) mid-plane ribbon fills (translucent, silk-weave overlay); (3) selvedge highlight strokes; (4) mote field; (5) bokeh halos (four to six large radialGradient circles, r = 60–120px, alpha 8–14%, positioned on axis columns, scale driven by swell); (6) text-safe cosine dim band; (7) lyric band — Cinzel word-by-word; (8) film grain (re-seeded every 3 frames); (9) anamorphic flare lines; (10) vignette. Grain and flare are the only layers drawn above text — both at opacity levels that cannot obscure it. All draw calls use save/restore; no globalCompositeOperation changes inside the ribbon loo
proposals.humanTrace: The silk weave texture is generated by a short canvas routine that draws diagonal strokes at hand-specified angle, weight, and spacing — the parameters were chosen by eye against reference photographs of real organza, then locked. The ribbon spline anchor positions were tuned by iterative visual inspection against the five-axis grid until the billow read as fabric and not as a wave function. The lyric tracking contraction (−0.01em per word) was set by reading the sample lines aloud and adjusting until the typographic breath matched a natural inhalation. These are acts of editorial judgment, not algorithmic outputs.
proposals.risk: Cinzel at this scale in a dark sanctuary is unambiguously ecclesiastical — some contemporary congregations will read it as too formal, too Catholic, too architectural. The risk is worth it because this is number seven of seventy-two and the collection needs at least one direction that asserts that worship has always had a nave, and that the nave's proportions are not a style but a technology for holding a large room's attention on a single idea. If the face reads as tradition, that is not a failure of the direction — it is the direction.

arguesWith.why: The Futurist will want the five axes to reconfigure dynamically — to breathe with the audio, to redistribute as the song modulates. I will not allow it. A measure that moves is not a measure; it is a suggestion. The entire argument of this direction is that the axes are declared before any draw call and never negotiated thereafter. proposals.title: Breath Pressed Into Silk
proposals.idea: The scene is a single long inhalation — fabric, light, and lyric all held in the same lung, released only when the voice does.
proposals.geometry: Five vertical depth axes declared as code constants before any draw call: far void (x≈0.08vw), deep fold (x≈0.27vw), mid veil (x≈0.50vw), near selvedge (x≈0.73vw), lyric plane (x≈0.92vw). Each ribbon bezier, god-ray sweep, mote cluster, and bokeh halo must answer to one of those five prior x-positions — the axes function as press registration marks, a physical commitment the whole render is accountable to. Horizontally the canvas holds a single low-tension arc: two anchored selvedge threads run from bottom-left to top-right at 8° off vertical, their curvature governed by one pre-declared sag constant (k=0.03). Everything else bends toward or away from those two threads. No grid cells, no symmetry — the geometry is tensile, not architectural.
proposals.typography: Cinzel, sentence case, tracked at +0.12em. Single lyric line occupies the lower third, vertically centred in the text-safe band. Type size: 4.2vw at 1080p, 3.8vw at 4K — large enough to read from forty metres, small enough to feel inscribed rather than broadcast. Word-by-word reveal: each incoming word fades up over 18 frames (0.3 s at 60 fps) at the same baseline; already-revealed words do not shift position. No slide, no push — the line accumulates like ink soaking into cloth. Line crossfade: outgoing line dims to 0 over 40 frames while incoming line holds at 0 until outgoing is fully clear, then begins its first word. Colour: #FAF0E4 at 92% opacity over the dimming band. The text-safe band is a vertical gradient from #0B0814 at 85% alpha at band-bottom to 0% alpha at band-top, spanning 28% of canvas height — the scene yields to it, not the other way around.
proposals.imageLogic: No concept plate, no imported asset. The procedural scene is the image. Two ribbon systems: SYSTEM A — three wide gossamer veils, each a cubic bezier with control points anchored to the five declared axes, rendered as filled paths with alpha 0.09–0.18 using a linear gradient fill (#2A1B3D→#C9965B→#FAF0E4) oriented along the veil's local tangent. SYSTEM B — twelve selvedge threads, each a thin bezier (lineWidth 0.6–1.4px) drawn in #C9965B at alpha 0.55, with a cached 4px Gaussian blur pass applied once per thread per 400ms repaint cycle, not every frame. God rays: four radial strokes from a declared polar origin (azimuth 34°, elevation 62°) drawn as tapered linear-gradient rectangles rotated to that angle, alpha 0.06–0.11, never recomputed mid-frame. Bokeh: sixteen fixed ellipses seeded from a 6×4 luminance grid computed once at scene init, radii 8–22px, #C9965B at alpha 0.07, no per-fram
proposals.texture: Material weave is the lead lens's signature here: a simulated paper-tooth noise layer, 128×128 tiled canvas, generated once at init by walking a pseudo-random displacement field and drawing 0.4px hairlines at 6° intervals in #FAF0E4 at alpha 0.03. This tile is composited over the full canvas at globalCompositeOperation 'overlay', opacity 0.18. It does not animate. It is the one thing that does not breathe — the fixed material fact under the moving light, the way the press sheet exists before the ink. Film grain: per-frame 2px Gaussian noise injected into a 64×64 offscreen canvas, scaled up and composited at alpha 0.04 — cheap, fast, present. 35mm light leak: a single radial gradient from the declared polar origin, #C9965B→transparent, radius 35% of canvas width, composited at 'screen' blending, alpha 0.08 base, audio-modulated.
proposals.motion: Three envelopes, all smoothed with a 0.06 lerp coefficient — nothing snaps. VOCAL amplitude → veil crest lift: the mid-control-point y of each veil bezier rises by up to 6% of canvas height; the motion is breath-paced, 0.4–1.2 Hz, never faster. SWELL (low-mid band energy) → champagne-gold rim translucency: the alpha ceiling of the selvedge thread blur rises from 0.55 to 0.82 and the light-leak overlay alpha rises from 0.08 to 0.16; this is the only moment the scene brightens. BASS → lower fold wavelength: the bottom control point of each veil bezier drifts laterally by up to 3% of canvas width, slowing the apparent wave; high bass = slower, longer fold; the motion is tidal, 0.1–0.3 Hz. The lyric band dims 12% additional alpha during swell peaks to protect legibility — the scene yields to the word when the light is loudest. Nothing strobes. proposals.productionMethod: Canvas 2D renderer, 60 fps target. Init phase: declare five axis constants, polar light origin, sag constant, 6×4 bokeh seed grid, paper-tooth tile, thread bezier anchors — all before first draw call. Per-frame budget allocation: bezier fill passes (≈3 large paths, cached gradient objects) → selvedge thread draw (12 thin paths, blur applied to offscreen canvas repainted every 400ms) → bokeh ellipses (16 fixed, alpha-only modulation) → god-ray rectangles (4, transform-only update) → paper-tooth overlay (static tile blit) → grain pass (64×64 offscreen, scaled blit) → light-leak overlay (radial gradient, alpha updated) → text-safe band gradient (static, pre-cached) → lyric layer (Cinzel, word accumulation logic). Integrated GPU safe: no WebGL, no shader passes, no video decode. The heaviest single operation is the selvedge blur offscreen canvas — repainted at 2.5 Hz, not 60 Hz.
proposals.humanTrace: The paper-tooth noise tile is generated by a pseudo-random walk that I directed to run at 6° hairline angle — that angle is not default, not zero, not 45°. It is a prior editorial decision, declared before the scene loads, and every frame composites over it. The 34° light-source azimuth is likewise a pre-declared human choice, not an auto-calculated optimum. The veil bezier sag constant (k=0.03) was chosen because 0.03 reads as cloth under slight tension, not slack, not taut — a material judgment. These three numbers are the handprint. They are not visible as numbers but they are visible as weight, angle, and breath.
proposals.risk: Cinzel over a near-black field with alpha 0.92 at 4.2vw is legible but austere — it refuses the warmth that Noto Serif or Outfit would provide. Some worship leaders will read it as cold. I am betting that Cinzel's inscribed quality — letterforms that feel cut rather than printed — matches the altar-ministry context better than a warmer humanist face would, and that the champagne-gold selvedge threads provide enough warmth to carry the cold letterforms. If I am wrong, the scene reads as funerary rather than reverent. That risk is worth taking because the alternative — Outfit at comfortable tracking with a soft glow — produces the screensaver the brief explicitly forbids.

arguesWith.why: The Baroque Dramatist will want the veil count higher, the god-ray count higher, the bokeh population denser, and the swell response more theatrical — a luminance surge that fills the frame. I am holding to three veils, four rays, sixteen bokeh points, and a swell response that lifts translucency by 0.08 alpha units, not a blaze. proposals.title: Silk Field as State Machine
proposals.idea: Every visual parameter is a derivable output of three audio channels feeding a single physically-plausible cloth-simulation state, so the scene has no decorative motion — only lawful response.
proposals.geometry: Three discrete depth planes on a fixed Z-axis contract: Plane 1 (z=0, background) is a slow radial gradient from #0B0814 at center-void to #2A1B3D at rim — a sealed aubergine chamber; Plane 2 (z=1, mid) carries two large bezier ribbon solids, each a single continuous cubic spline with four mutable control points, occupying 60–80% of viewport width, stacked vertically at 38% and 62% of viewport height as rest-state anchors — their geometry is a derived output of audio state, not a preset animation; Plane 3 (z=2, fore) holds the lyric band in a locked horizontal safe-zone: 72px bottom margin, full-bleed width, 18% viewport height — this plane never moves, never reacts to audio amplitude, is composited last so nothing bleeds through it; the motes and rim-light halos live between z=1 and z=2 as a sparse sampled field, maximum 18 particles at any frame to honour the integrated-GPU constraint.
proposals.typography: Cinzel, sentence-case, tracked at +0.08em — chosen because its roman proportions hold at 4K projection distance without collapsing into a blur, and its axis is vertical-stress which rhymes with the ribbon's vertical fold rhythm; active lyric line at 3.2vw / clamp(32px,3.2vw,64px); word-by-word reveal uses opacity ramp 0→1 over 180ms per word with no translate — position is sacred and never animated; preceding line ghosts at 18% opacity, 2.4vw, same tracking; text-safe dimming band is a 140px-tall gradient from rgba(11,8,20,0.0) at top edge to rgba(11,8,20,0.72) at bottom, always present, computed before the lyric composite — the ribbons must fall below 22% luminance inside this band, enforced by a luminance clamp uniform in the draw call; colour: #FAF0E4 at full opacity for active word, #C9965B at 60% for ghost line.
proposals.imageLogic: There is no photograph and no concept plate. The scene is entirely procedural. The 'material' of the silk is synthesised: each ribbon's fill is a multi-stop linear gradient along the spline's normal vector — stops are #FAF0E4 at the specular ridge (position derived from the 35°/22° light axiom), #C9965B at the body, #2A1B3D at the shadow trough; a second gradient pass composited in 'screen' mode at 0.18 opacity simulates translucency by reading the background plane luminance at each ribbon pixel and adding a proportional champagne tint — this is the fake sub-surface scatter that makes it read as gossamer rather than matte cloth; the selvedge thread is a 1.5px canvas stroke along the spline path in #C9965B at 80% opacity, offset 3px outward from the ribbon edge — it is redrawn every frame so it bends with the spline.
proposals.texture: Film grain is a pre-generated 512×512 tileable noise canvas (Gaussian, sigma=18) composited as 'overlay' at 6% opacity each frame — generated once at init, never regenerated, zero per-frame GPU cost; the material weave for this lens is a fine-interval crosshatch distortion field: a 4×4 pixel repeating displacement map (hard-coded as a Float32Array of 16 signed offset pairs, values ±1.2px) applied to the ribbon draw coordinates before the spline is stroked — this gives the silk a woven tooth that is visible at close range on an LED wall and invisible at 40 metres from the back pew, where it reads as surface richness rather than noise; the 35mm light-leak is a single large radial gradient (ellipse, 80% × 40% viewport) at the top-left quadrant, rgba(201,150,91,0.07), composited in 'screen' — fixed position derived from the 35°/22° light axiom, not animated, not random.
proposals.motion: The state machine has three inputs and one steady state. Steady state: both ribbons drift on a 0.003 radians/frame slow Lissajous — control points trace ellipses with radii 4% and 2.5% of viewport height, period approximately 28 seconds, no two points on the same phase — this is the breath of the sanctuary at silence. Vocal amplitude (smoothed, 80ms envelope): maps to the vertical displacement of the upper ribbon's two inner control points — at amplitude 0 the crest sits at 38% viewport height; at amplitude 1.0 the crest lifts to 29% viewport height; the lift is spring-damped (spring k=0.04, damping=0.82) so it trails the voice by roughly one beat and settles without bounce. Swell (low-mid band, 200–800Hz RMS, 200ms envelope): maps to the gradient stop opacity on the specular ridge — at swell 0 the rim highlight is rgba(250,240,228,0.55); at swell 1.0 it is rgba(250,240,228,0.92) — this
proposals.productionMethod: Canvas 2D, 60fps, integrated-GPU safe. One offscreen canvas for the grain texture, generated at init. One offscreen canvas for the displacement map, 4×4, generated at init. Main draw loop: (1) background gradient fill; (2) light-leak ellipse in screen mode; (3) lower ribbon: compute spline control points from Lissajous + bass state, fill gradient, stroke selvedge; (4) upper ribbon: compute control points from Lissajous + vocal state, fill gradient, stroke selvedge; (5) motes: draw 18 circles from Halton positions, radius and opacity from swell state; (6) text-safe dimming band gradient; (7) lyric composite — ghost line then active line, word opacity states driven by a 4-second per-line timer with 180ms per-word ramp; (8) grain overlay in 'overlay' mode at 6%; (9) anamorphic flare: a 1px-tall, 60%-width horizontal gradient streak at the specular ridge Y coordinate, rgba(250,240,228,0.04),
proposals.humanTrace: The selvedge thread stroke is redrawn every frame along a live spline — its slight sub-pixel jitter as the control points drift is not noise added for texture but the natural aliasing of Canvas 2D arc rendering at irrational coordinates, which produces a barely-perceptible shimmer that reads as thread catching light; this is the system's honest imperfection, produced by the renderer's own rounding behaviour, not by a noise function layered on top.
proposals.risk: The risk is that 'no animation except audio response' reads as broken or frozen to a volunteer who has never seen the scene sing — the ribbons at silence move so slowly (28-second Lissajous) that a cold-start operator may think the visualizer has stalled. This is worth it because the alternative — adding a default idle animation loop — would make the audio-reactive state feel like an add-on rather than the primary system, and the entire contract of the direction is that audio response IS the motion, not a modifier of it. Mitigation: a first-load 800ms initialization sweep lifts both ribbons 6% and returns them, confirming the system is live.

I reject this on system grounds: if the reveal is the experience, the steady state becomes the afterthought, and a worship visualizer runs in steady state for four to six minutes per song. proposals.title: Provenance of Light Through Cloth
proposals.idea: Every visual element — ribbon axis, mote cluster, rim-haze gradient, lyric interval — is derived from the declared geometry of woven silk selvedge structure, so that the fabric's physical logic precedes every draw call and the scene feels inhabited rather than generated.
proposals.geometry: Five vertical bay axes, spaced in a 1:1.618 cascade from screen centre-left, each bay hosting one gossamer ribbon plane at a distinct depth z-index (0 = deep aubergine void ground, 1 = slow-undulating amethyst ground veil, 2 = mid champagne-gold ribbon, 3 = fore-gossamer overlay, 4 = selvedge-thread haze). The ribbon geometry is a Bézier spine whose four control points are locked to the bay proportions — not freehand. The lyric band occupies the lower 22% of canvas height, resting on a text-safe dimming plane that is itself one depth layer, never floating. God-ray shafts originate from a single declared azimuth: 28° from screen-top-right, held without exception across every layer. Mote clusters inherit their x-positions from the five bay axes, never scattered at random.
proposals.typography: Cinzel, uppercase, 3.2vw at 1080p (scales proportionally to 4K), tracking 0.22em — chosen because Cinzel's Roman proportion carries the weight of liturgical text without denominational branding. Word-by-word reveal over 4–5 seconds per line: each incoming word fades in at 320ms opacity ease-out, sitting beside its predecessor with no positional shift — the line is fully kerned and centred before reveal begins, so no reflow jitter. Active line: full #FAF0E4 at 94% opacity. Previous line: drops to 28% opacity over 600ms, held for one line-duration then fades to 0. The dimming band beneath is a radial gradient: #0B0814 at 72% opacity at band-bottom, easing to 0% at 40% above the baseline — it widens by 4px on every Swell amplitude increase, never narrows faster than 800ms. No other typefaces enter. No italic. No mixed case. Measure: never wider than 68% of canvas width. Minimum rendered siz
proposals.imageLogic: No concept plate. The scene is entirely procedural. Ribbon geometry: each ribbon is a canvas 2D Bézier curve rendered at 3px stroke width with a radial gradient fill along its spine — champagne #C9965B at peak crests, bleeding toward #2A1B3D in the fold troughs. Translucency is a globalAlpha value per ribbon layer (0.18 to 0.55) that the Swell channel modulates upward. The selvedge-thread haze is a separate pass: 80–120 near-vertical lines, each 1px wide, globalAlpha 0.06–0.14, distributed along bay axes with a ±3px horizontal Perlin drift per frame — this is the only high-count element and it is stroked not filled, keeping GPU load minimal. God-ray shafts: three radial gradient rectangles, rotated to 28°, drawn once per frame as large cached shapes. Bokeh motes: 24 circles, radius 6–18px, globalAlpha 0.08–0.22, positions seeded from bay-axis intersections with mote-cluster depth — not r
proposals.texture: The tactile material weave for this direction is simulated silk-organza: a cached 256×256 tile generated once at init — fine horizontal lines at 0.5px opacity 0.07, crossed by vertical threads at 0.3px opacity 0.04, with a 1px Gaussian noise pass at 3% amplitude, composited over the full canvas at globalAlpha 0.09 in 'overlay' blend mode. This is the Council optical pass material weave for this lens. The 35mm light-leak pass is a single off-canvas gradient rectangle (warm amber #C9965B at 8% opacity) swept across the upper-right corner at the declared 28° azimuth, refreshed every 90 seconds with a 4-second ease — not per-frame, so it reads as a slow environmental shift, not a pulse. Film grain: a 512×512 noise canvas, pre-generated at init, cycled through four offset positions at 12fps (not 60fps) to stay cheap — globalAlpha 0.04. Colour punch: a full-canvas multiply pass, #2A1B3D at 12%
proposals.motion: Hierarchy: Vocal drives ribbon crest undulation. Swell drives rim translucency and dimming-band width. Bass drives lower-fold wavelength and slows it. Envelope: all audio values pass through a 0.08 attack / 0.94 release exponential smoother — nothing steps, nothing strobes. Ribbon animation: each ribbon's mid-control-point y-position drifts on a sine wave, base period 7–11 seconds per ribbon (staggered so no two peak together), Vocal amplitude adds ±0.6× the ribbon's bay-height to that drift. At zero Vocal input, ribbons still breathe at their base period — the scene is never static. Swell: linearly interpolates each ribbon's globalAlpha toward its Swell-modulated ceiling (max 0.62) at 0.003 per frame — slow enough to feel like fabric catching light rather than a parameter change. Bass: modulates the lower-fold control-point period — at zero Bass, period is 9 seconds; at full Bass, perio
proposals.productionMethod: Canvas 2D renderer, 60fps target on integrated GPU. Init sequence: (1) Declare five bay axes as code constants from canvas width. (2) Declare 28° azimuth as a single constant used by god-ray rotation, bokeh seed offset, and light-leak gradient angle simultaneously. (3) Pre-generate: aubergine void gradient (once), silk-organza tile (256×256, once), grain canvas (512×512, once), four grain offset positions (array, once). (4) Per-frame draw order: void ground → god-ray shafts → amethyst ground veil ribbon → mid champagne ribbon → fore-gossamer ribbon → selvedge-thread haze → bokeh motes → colour punch multiply → grain composite → light-leak gradient → text-safe dimming band → lyric band. Audio analysis: Web Audio API AnalyserNode, FFT 1024, three band extractors (Vocal: 300–3400Hz RMS, Swell: 80–300Hz RMS, Bass: 20–80Hz RMS), each passed through independent exponential envelope. proposals.humanTrace: The five bay axes and the 28° azimuth are declared as named constants in the first twelve lines of the renderer — not discovered in layout, not approximated per layer, but written as physical law before any draw call. Every ribbon spine, every mote cluster, every thread drift, every god-ray rotation, every light-leak angle is answerable to those two declarations. This is the same discipline as provenance: the source geometry is named first and everything else must cite it. The silk-organza weave tile is generated from a specific thread-count decision — 0.5px horizontal at 7% opacity, 0.3px vertical at 4% — not a generic noise pass. Those numbers came from observing how organza at 30 threads-per-centimetre reads on a lit altar from 15 metres: the horizontal weft dominates, the vertical warp is felt rather than seen. That observation is the human trace. It is not photographed; it is transc
proposals.risk: The risk is that five bay axes and a declared azimuth read as architectural rigidity in a scene that should feel like billowing cloth — that the geometry disciplines the fabric into stiffness. The reason it is worth that risk: every other direction in this room will reach for softness through randomness, and randomness in a worship context reads as indifference. Structure that breathes is more reverent than scatter that undulates. The ribbon sine-wave stagger and the per-ribbon period variation (7 to 11 seconds) are the answer to the rigidity risk — they produce non-repeating asymmetry within a declared frame, which is exactly how woven cloth behaves: the warp is strict, the drape is free.

arguesWith.why: The Baroque Dramatist will want to dissolve the bay-axis structure into full-canvas swells — more ribbon planes, higher opacity peaks, the god-rays sweeping rather than anchored. I expect the argument: that worship requires overwhelming beauty, not measured proportion. My answer: the Baroque reach for grandeur before discipline produces scenes that compete with the lyric rather than yield to it. T

proposals.title: The Veil Lifted, Breathing
proposals.idea: A single translucent silk curtain — painted in code as layered Bézier ribbons with physically-plausible rim-lit chiaroscuro — rises through a deep aubergine void in the rhythm of the singer's breath, so that every lyric line appears not on a screen but within an act of liturgical unveiling.
proposals.geometry: Three depth planes stacked on a vertical axis: (1) Background void — a radial gradient from #0B0814 at the corners bleeding toward #2A1B3D at center, occupying the full canvas, establishing the sanctuary dark; (2) Mid-plane — four to six large Bézier ribbon forms, each 60–80% of canvas height, displaced horizontally so their crests stagger at different Y positions, overlapping to create fabric occlusion and genuine translucent depth; ribbons are not symmetrical — they carry a 7–12° composite lean so the composition breathes rightward like a slow exhale; (3) Foreground scrim — a single wider, lower-opacity gossamer veil that drifts across the lyric band zone, its opacity ceiling capped at 0.18 so it never competes with text; the lyric band itself occupies the canonical lower-third, vertically centered between 58% and 78% of canvas height, with the dimming band extending 6% above and below
proposals.typography: Cinzel, display weight, for the lyric line — set at 3.8vw (scales to ~4K without recompute), all-caps with tracking at 0.22em; this is the sanctuary inscription, not the caption. Word-by-word reveal uses a per-word opacity ramp (0 → 1 over 18 frames, eased cubic-out) with a simultaneous 4px upward translate that lands at rest — the word arrives like a candle being raised, not typed. Active word: #FAF0E4 at full opacity. Words already spoken: #FAF0E4 at 0.45 opacity, held — the line stays present, dimming to memory. Incoming word glows at a champagne-gold tint (#C9965B blended at 12%) on the frame it lands, then resolves to #FAF0E4 within 8 frames — a momentary gilding that marks the breath point. No italic, no shadow: the depth contract is held by the dimming band alone. A hairline rule in #C9965B at 0.6px, 180px wide, sits 18px above the lyric line — the proscenium edge, the curtain thr
proposals.imageLogic: No photographs, no footage — this is the generative premise held absolutely. The 'image' is built from: (a) ribbon geometry computed as multi-segment cubic Bézier paths with 8–12 control points per ribbon, perturbed each frame by a low-frequency noise field (simplex noise, octave 1, frequency 0.003, amplitude driven by vocal envelope); (b) a rim-light pass simulated by computing each ribbon's tangent normal and assigning a highlight strip — a radial gradient from #FAF0E4 at 0.7 opacity on the lit edge to full transparency 40px inward — positioned as though the key light originates from the upper-left at approximately 135° from vertical, consistent with a single source at 4000K; (c) spun-gold selvedge threads rendered as 1–2px Canvas strokes in #C9965B at 0.5–0.8 opacity, tracing the ribbon edge with a slight waver (±3px noise offset per 60px of length); (d) bokeh layer: 12–18 soft circul
proposals.texture: Simulated gossamer silk: each ribbon fill is a linear gradient from #2A1B3D (deep fold shadow) through a mid-value of #C9965B at low opacity (0.12–0.22, the champagne warmth caught in the weave) to #FAF0E4 at the lit crest (0.3–0.5 opacity) — the translucency is real in the math, not faked with a blur. A fine grain pass (Canvas 2D: per-frame noise texture drawn at 0.04 opacity, 1px noise, seeded to frame count so it shifts without strobing) sits over the entire canvas — this is the film grain of the optical pass, tactile proof that a real emulsion once touched this light. The material weave keyed to this lens: foil-stamped liturgical brocade, as if the silk ribbons were woven on a loom that also carries gold wire — the selvedge thread shader replicates this by brightening thread opacity when the swell envelope rises above 0.6.
proposals.motion: Vocal amplitude → ribbon crest height: each ribbon's uppermost control point lifts 0 to 40px above its resting Y position, spring-damped (stiffness 0.04, damping 0.72) so it follows the vocal phrase and settles between phrases like a breath held then released. This is the primary drama: the fabric breathes with the singer. Swell envelope → champagne rim translucency: the highlight strip opacity on all ribbons scales from 0.35 (rest) to 0.70 (full swell), giving the moment of harmonic peak a literal brightening of the veil — the sanctuary light increases as the congregation sings together. Bass envelope → lower fold wavelength: the lower control points of each ribbon slow their noise traversal rate (noise frequency multiplied by 1 – bass×0.6), so at bass peaks the folds become deeper, slower, more solemn — gravity re-enters the zero-gravity fabric. The ribbons do not teleport or reset; th
proposals.productionMethod: Canvas 2D real-time renderer. Ribbon geometry: pre-computed Bézier control point arrays, perturbed each frame by a simplex noise field evaluated at (x * 0.003 + time * 0.0004, y * 0.003). Ribbon fills: createLinearGradient per ribbon per frame, three colour stops as specified. Rim highlight: second Canvas path drawn over each ribbon with a narrow radial gradient, normal computed from the Bézier tangent. Selvedge threads: strokeStyle paths with lineWidth 1.5, shadow blur 3 in #C9965B. Grain: a 200×200 offscreen canvas pre-seeded with random greyscale noise, redrawn every 3 frames (not every frame — halves cost), composited at 0.04 globalAlpha. Bokeh: pre-cached offscreen radial gradients, translated each frame. All audio envelopes: Web Audio API AnalyserNode, smoothingTimeConstant 0.88 for vocal and swell, 0.92 for bass; all values spring-damped before reaching visual properties. Dimming
proposals.humanTrace: The ribbon geometry is not algorithmic wallpaper — the initial Bézier control point positions are hand-placed (authored as explicit coordinate arrays) to establish a specific compositional lean: the tallest crest slightly left of center, the widest fold draping into the lower-right, the selvedge thread prominent on the front ribbon's right edge. This is a staged composition, not a random scatter. The rim-light angle (135° from vertical, upper-left source) is a deliberate lighting decision authored once and propagated without exception into every highlight strip, bokeh catch-light, and thread shimmer — one declared light source conducting the entire scene, the way a gaffer sets a single key and lets it define every surface. The word-gilding at landing (the 8-frame champagne bloom on each arriving word) is a performance timing decision: it marks the breath, the syllable, the moment of utte
proposals.risk: The risk is that this direction is unapologetically gorgeous — the ribbons are large, the chiaroscuro is real, the gilded word-bloom is a felt moment — and a congregation or operator expecting something quieter may read it as overwrought. That risk is worth carrying because the brief explicitly names Holy Spirit invocation and altar ministry: these are the liturgical moments that historically demanded the most beautiful objects a community could produce. Restraint here is not humility, it is abdication. The second risk is GPU cost on the ribbon fill recompute; it is managed by capping ribbon count at six and pre-caching the grain texture, but it must be profiled on the target integrated GPU before release.

arguesWith.why: The Minimalist will argue that the word alone, on the void, is sufficient — that every ribbon, every selvedge thread, every bokeh sphere is noise competing with the lyric. I reject this on liturgical grounds: the sanctuary has never been bare. The veil, the censer smoke, the candlelight — these are not decoration, they are the material form of reverence. proposals.title: One Breath, One Fold
proposals.idea: The entire scene is one slow exhalation — a single silk fold that opens, holds, and subsides with the singer's breath, so that every visual event is a consequence of the vocal envelope and nothing else.
proposals.geometry: Three depth planes derived from a single governing ratio: the golden section applied once, vertically. Plane 1 (far): a near-black aubergine void, #0B0814, occupying the lower 61.8% of the frame — the silence below. Plane 2 (mid): one large gossamer fold, procedurally generated as a cubic Bézier surface whose four control points sit on the 38.2% horizontal axis; the fold occupies the full width and drifts between 30% and 65% of frame height across its wave period. Plane 3 (near): a single spun-gold selvedge thread — one hairline, weight 0.5–1.2 px depending on DPR — running horizontally at the 38.2% line, the only hard edge in the scene. No decorative borders. No secondary ribbons unless the vocal swell pushes a second fold in from the right edge; that second fold earns its entry or does not appear. The text-safe dimming band occupies the lower 23% of the frame — below the 38.2% axis — a
proposals.typography: Cinzel, all-caps, tracked at +0.18em, set at 3.2vw on 1080p (scales to 2.8vw at 4K to stay optically consistent from the back pew). One lyric line at a time. Word-by-word reveal: each word fades in at 180ms opacity ease-out, no slide, no bounce — stillness is the transition. The completed line holds at full opacity for the remainder of its four-to-five-second window, then fades at 320ms. Colour: #FAF0E4 at 96% opacity against the dimming band. The dimming band is #0B0814 at 72% opacity, blurred 8px upward into the scene so it dissolves rather than cuts. No drop shadow on the type — the band is the shadow. Letter-spacing does not animate. Scale does not animate. The words arrive; the words remain; the words leave. That is all.
proposals.imageLogic: No concept plate. The scene is entirely procedural. The silk fold is a Canvas 2D path: a horizontal cubic Bézier whose Y-control-points are driven by a Perlin noise field sampled at 0.04 Hz base rate. The fold's fill is a radial gradient from #C9965B at 28% opacity at the crest to #2A1B3D at 0% opacity at the trough — translucency is baked into the gradient stop, not into globalAlpha, so the void reads through without a separate compositing pass. The selvedge thread is a single strokePath call, colour #C9965B, with a luminance envelope driven by the swell channel (0.6–1.0 opacity range, smoothed over 400ms). God-ray pass: three canvas gradient fills radiating from a point at 38.2% horizontal, 12% vertical — fixed position, no animation on origin — with width varying ±4% on a 7-second sine, driven by no audio channel, because the light source does not breathe. Mote field: eight motes maxi
proposals.texture: The kit's material weave for this lead lens is linen-silence: a cached 256×256 Canvas noise texture, generated once at init, overlaid at 4% opacity in 'soft-light' composite mode. Grain is present but not readable as grain — it is the difference between a monitor and a wall. Film grain from the optical pass runs at 1.2% intensity, applied as a full-frame noise overlay refreshed every 3 frames (not every frame — the stillness of the grain is part of the texture). No anamorphic flare unless the swell channel exceeds 0.85 amplitude for more than 800ms continuously — at that threshold, one horizontal flare streak, #FAF0E4 at 18% opacity, 3px height, full width, fades in over 600ms and out over 1200ms. One flare. It earns its place or it does not appear.
proposals.motion: Vocal envelope → fold crest height: the Bézier Y-control-points rise by up to 8% of frame height at peak vocal amplitude, smoothed with a 220ms attack, 800ms release spring-damped envelope. The fold does not jump; it lifts like a held breath. Swell channel → champagne-gold rim translucency: the gradient stop at the fold crest moves from 28% to 46% opacity, 400ms smooth. Bass channel → lower fold wavelength: the Perlin sampling rate drops from 0.04 Hz to 0.018 Hz, stretching the wave period so the bottom of the fold moves more slowly and more heavily. No channel drives position of words. No channel drives mote count. No channel drives the selvedge thread position. The thread is fixed; it is the one thing that does not breathe.
proposals.productionMethod: Canvas 2D renderer in Plajah's existing worship visualizer kit. Init: generate and cache the linen noise texture (256×256, one draw call). Per-frame draw order: 1) fill #0B0814 void; 2) draw three god-ray gradient fills (fixed origin, slow sine on width only); 3) draw the silk fold Bézier path with radial gradient fill; 4) draw the selvedge hairline; 5) draw eight motes as radial gradient circles; 6) overlay linen texture in soft-light; 7) apply film grain overlay (refreshed every 3 frames); 8) apply dimming band gradient at bottom 23%; 9) render lyric band (Cinzel, word-by-word, inside the dimming zone). Audio analysis: Web Audio API AnalyserNode, three smoothed envelopes — vocal (2kHz–8kHz RMS), swell (200Hz–2kHz RMS), bass (20Hz–200Hz RMS) — each passed through a lerp with the frame-appropriate smoothing coefficient. All Perlin noise uses a single shared noise module, seeded at build
proposals.humanTrace: Editorial selection: the decision to use eight motes instead of eighty; the decision to place the god-ray origin at 38.2% not at centre; the decision that the selvedge thread does not animate. These are not defaults — they are cuts. The grain overlay refreshed every third frame rather than every frame is a timing choice that makes the texture feel like film rather than noise. The 0.5–1.2px selvedge hairline weight is a proportion decision made at the pixel level. The flare threshold of 0.85 amplitude held for 800ms is a judgment about when a moment has earned decoration. These are the marks of making.
proposals.risk: The risk is that congregants read it as empty — that one fold, eight motes, and a hairline feel unfinished against the expectation of silk's abundance. That risk is worth taking because the alternative — more ribbons, more threads, more motes — produces a screensaver, which the brief explicitly forbids. The emptiness here is not absence of effort; it is the structural argument that the voice is the event, and the scene's job is to hold space for it without competing. If the fold is right, the congregation will not notice the fold. They will notice the words, and they will feel the room breathe.

arguesWith.why: The Dramatist will want more ribbons — a second fold, a third, layered translucency, a fuller canopy of silk. The Dramatist is right that silk is inherently plural and that the premise says 'ribbons' (plural). I am saying that one fold rendered with precision is more silk than ten folds rendered with approximation, and that the second ribbon only earns its place when the vocal swell pushes it in —

disputes.objection: The word-gilding — a champagne bloom on each arriving word, resolved over eight frames — announces the reveal rather than delivering it; the ornament precedes the content and tells the eye what to feel before the feeling has been earned, which is the structural error I must name: a proscenium that dresses itself in front of the audience. The hairline rule above the lyric line compounds this, adding a secondary hierarchy marker where the dimming band already does that work, so the composition carries two authorities where one would govern. When the rim-light angle, the thread shimmer, the bokeh catch-light, and the word-gilding all perform simultaneously at a swell peak, the scene has no quie
disputes.concession: The single declared light source at 135° from vertical, propagated without exception into every highlight strip and thread shimmer, is exactly the structural discipline I require: one cantus firmus conducting every surface, and that is right.

disputes.objection: One fold, one thread, eight motes — the editing is so severe it stops being a cut and becomes a policy, and policy is not the same as risk. The selvedge thread that does not animate is held up as human trace, but refusing to move something is an editorial position disguised as restraint — the thread is controlled, not alive, and control is exactly what the Minimalist wants but calls discipline. When the swell pushes above 0.85 for 800ms before a flare is allowed to exist, the work has written a constitution for its own suppression; the moment has to earn permission from a rule the rule already won.
disputes.concession: The grain refreshed every third frame instead of every frame is right — that is a timing decision with a physical logic, the difference between noise and film, and it is the kind of mark I would fight to keep.

disputes.objection: The rim-light angle is declared once (135° from vertical, upper-left) and then the brief claims this single source 'conducts the entire scene' — but the proposal never writes that angle into a shader uniform or a named constant that downstream parameters derive from; it is described as a lighting decision and then re-applied by hand to each element (highlight strip, bokeh catch-light, thread shimmer) as if repetition were the same as derivation. That is not a system, it is a style guide. The word-gilding — an 8-frame champagne bloom on each arriving word — is the clearest symptom: it is a reveal layered onto a reveal, spectacle checking that the first spectacle was noticed, with no rule gove
disputes.concession: The spring-damped ribbon crest (stiffness 0.04, damping 0.72) is the most precisely specified motion contract on the table, and naming those two constants rather than describing the effect qualitatively is exactly the kind of systems discipline I want to see more of.

disputes.objection: The 135° rim-light origin and the 7–12° compositional lean are declared as authorial decisions, but neither is traced to a sourced place or a named making tradition — they arrive as theatrical intuition dressed as physical law, which is exactly how borrowed grandeur hides its provenance; when the Dramatist says 'the tallest crest slightly left of center, the widest fold draping into the lower-right,' that is a compositional habit, not a declared constraint, and a habit cannot propagate as a governing axiom the way a true prior declaration can. The word-gilding — the 8-frame champagne bloom — performs emotion rather than deriving it from the audio state, which means the scene has two emotiona
disputes.concession: The insistence that ribbons never teleport or reset — that continuity is a structural commitment, not a convenience — is exactly right, and every other direction on this table benefits from holding that same standard.

disputes.objection: One fold is not a decision — it is a refusal. The Minimalist has mistaken parsimony for drama: a single Bézier crest that lifts eight percent on a vocal peak is not an event, it is a suggestion, and a sanctuary full of people reaching for something larger than themselves deserves more than a suggestion. The text-safe band, the selvedge thread that does not move, the eight motes that earn nothing by being eight rather than eighty — this is an entire direction built on the rhetoric of restraint while quietly avoiding the harder question of what the work should feel like at the moment the lyric breaks open.
disputes.concession: The flare threshold — one flare, earned by 800ms of sustained amplitude above 0.85 — is genuinely theatrical thinking: it understands that a reveal requires a before, and that the before must be long enough to make the audience feel the waiting.

disputes.objection: The 4px upward translate on each arriving word, the 8-frame champagne bloom at landing, the hairline proscenium rule, the foil-brocade selvedge brightening — each one is a small theatrical gesture that might justify itself alone, but stacked they constitute a budget of decoration that the brief never authorized; the scene is not unveiling anything, it is announcing that it is unveiling, which is the opposite of silence. The ribbon lean at 7–12° rightward, described as 'breathes like an exhale,' is a composed affect — the geometry is performing emotion rather than structuring it, and that distinction is the difference between drama and meaning.
disputes.concession: The single declared rim-light source at 135° propagated without exception into every highlight, bokeh catch-light, and thread shimmer is exactly right — one light source held absolutely is an act of reduction, and I would keep that axiom and strip everything built on top of it.

synthesis.keepFromCounterpoint: The flare threshold principle: spectacular moments must be earned by duration, not triggered by amplitude alone. Applied here — the anamorphic flare streaks are held at 6% opacity at rest and only reach 10% if Swell sustains above 0.75 for more than 600ms continuously, then eases back. One escalation path, gated by time, so the congregation feels the before.
synthesis.editorCut: The Futurist removed three elements: (1) the word-gilding — the 8-frame champagne bloom on each arriving word — on the grounds that it is a reveal layered onto a reveal, announcing the moment rather than delivering it, and that the Cinzel letterform at this scale is already the event; (2) the hairline proscenium rule above the lyric line, because the dimming band already holds that authority and two governing marks compete rather than resolve; (3) per-ribbon gradient recomputation every frame fo
synthesis.openDecision: Ribbon count: four veils or six? Four gives the integrated GPU more headroom and the composition more air — the fold reads as singular, costly, present. Six fills the void more completely and makes the fabric feel abundant, closer to the premise's 'billowing gossamer ribbons' (plural, plural). This is a felt judgment about whether the scene should feel like one great curtain or a layered sanctuary
synthesis.ariaSummary:
The team landed here after a real argument, and I want to name it plainly. The Baroque Dramatist made the case that altar ministry and Holy Spirit invocation are the liturgical moments that historically demanded the most beautiful objects a community could produce — that restraint in this context is abdication, not humility. The Radical Minimalist answered that one fold rendered with precision is more silk than ten rendered with approximation, and that the scene's job is to hold space for the voice without competing. I came down with the Baroque direction, because the premise names flowing gossamer ribbons in the plural, the brief names Holy Spirit invocation specifically, and a single Bézier crest lifting eight percent does not fill a sanctuary. The congregation needs to feel the room breathe with the singer, not watch a parameter update.

The Futurist served as editor and made three cuts I accepted without resistance. The word-gilding — a champagne bloom on each arriving word — went first: it announces the reveal instead of being the reveal, and Cinzel at 3.8vw in a dark room is already the event. The hairline proscenium rule above the lyric line went second: the dimming band already holds that structural authority, and two authorities in the same zone compete. Per-frame gradient recomputation on all six ribbons went third, replaced by delta-gated updates — the GPU budget on an integrated chip is not theoretical, and the Futurist was right to enforce it.

The one thing I kept from the Minimalist is the earned-flare principle: the anamorphic streaks from the kit's optical pass exist at rest as 6% barely-there light, and only open toward 10% if Swell holds above 0.75 for more than 600ms. The Minimalist said a moment must earn its decoration. That is correct. I kept the decoration and kept the gate.

The decision left for you is ribbon count — four or six. Both are within GPU budget. Four gives the composition more air and makes each fold feel singular and costly. Six fills the void more completely and honours the premise's plural ribbons. I have built the direction to work either way; this is a felt call about your congregation and your room.

quotes.line: The emptiness here is not absence of effort; it is the structural argument that the voice is the event, and the scene's job is to hold space for it without competing.
The word-gilding — an 8-frame champagne bloom on each arriving word — is a reveal layered onto a reveal, spectacle checking that the first spectacle was noticed, with no rule governing it.
